role: algebra of sentences of the fixed language modulo logical equivalence
notes: Lindenbaum algebra of the language of def:p15-power-language; local to this chapter.

notes: Instance of Delta_P of def:p15-r43-polarity with P=P_r; no new concept.

notes: r_S(U)=r(U and S)/r(S); same operation as Merin's P_A of def:p15-r43-polarity applied to r.

notes: Finite-case instance of the coverage of def:p15-confidence-procedure with target tau(theta)=theta; chapter-local.

notes: Prior-times-likelihood joint law; Q_pi(C(x)|x) is the posterior content of the reported set; chapter-local.
